Container.Name: HoYo-Code-Sender
Container.Overview:
Discord bot that automatically checks for and posts redemption codes for Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, and Zenless Zone Zero. Original bot by chiraitori; this container and Unraid template are maintained by BomberPilot1.
Requires your own Discord bot application and a reachable MongoDB database. Enter your Discord token, application ID, and MongoDB connection string before starting.
For a local MongoDB container, select the same user-defined Docker network for both containers and use MongoDB's container name and internal port 27017 in MONGODB_URI. MongoDB may also be hosted elsewhere, such as MongoDB Atlas.
After startup, configure the bot in Discord using /setup and /toggleautosend. Configuration and history are stored in MongoDB. This image runs the Discord bot; the separate Next.js dashboard is not started.
Livestream tracking can be enabled or disabled in the template. An optional YouTube Data API key improves YouTube live/upcoming status and schedule detection. The web/API port defaults to host port 3000 and container port 3000; change the host port if it is already in use. The WebUI link opens the bot's built-in web server, not the separate Next.js dashboard.
This is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with HoYoverse.
Container.Requires: Your own Discord bot token and application ID, plus a reachable MongoDB database. The image is built for linux/amd64.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Keep this value private.

Config.Name: Discord application ID
Config.Description: Application ID from General Information in the Discord Developer Portal. It must belong to the same application as DISCORD_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Livestream tracking
Config.Description: Enable livestream and HoYoLAB post tracking. Choose true to enable or false to disable.

Config.Name: MongoDB connection URI
Config.Description: Your MongoDB connection string, including database name and credentials. For containers on the same user-defined network, use the MongoDB container name and its internal port 27017. Example: mongodb://USER:PASSWORD@mongodb:27017/hoyo?authSource=admin

Config.Name: Discord owner user ID (optional)
Config.Description: Your Discord user ID for owner-specific commands. Enable Developer Mode in Discord to copy your user ID.

Config.Name: YouTube API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional YouTube Data API key for improved livestream status and schedule detection. Keep this value private.

Config.Name: Web / API port
Config.Description: Host port for the bot's built-in web/API server. Change the host port if 3000 is already in use. This is not the separate Next.js dashboard.
